stories.title: Irã tenta reabrir negociações de paz e envia aos EUA novas condições para fim da guerra

en.title: Saint or sinner? 10 works that show why Mary Magdalene is one of the Bible's most controversial figures
en.summary: Mary Magdalene remains one of the most fascinating biblical figures, credited as the first witness to Christ's resurrection, though the Bible provides limited references to her, allowing mythology to obscure historical understanding.

en.summary: Mary Magdalene remains one of the most fascinating figures in biblical history, depicted across numerous artistic works that reflect her complex and disputed portrayal.

en.summary: Details have emerged about the connection between Paulo Gonet and Vorcaro, including shared interests and documented interactions.

en.summary: The Lula campaign is organizing daily grassroots activities for supporters to counter a rival candidate's growing momentum in polling numbers.

stories.title: BNDES já recebeu R$ 8,2 bi em pedidos de empréstimo no Plano Brasil Soberano

stories.title: Encantar o Brasil é olhar pro jovem e pra 'base'
